title: Mango Habanero Salsa
summary: Sweet mango, cool cucumber, and habanero heat with lime and cilantro. Almost no fat, and it carries a lean bowl.

ingredients.raw: 1.5 cups firm ripe mango, small dice
1/2 to 1 habanero, seeds and ribs removed, minced very fine

steps.body: Toss the salsa together, starting with half the habanero. Let it sit at least 15 min, then taste. Wear gloves.

notes.body: Makes about 2.5 cups. A serving is 1/2 cup.
**Let the salsa sit.** The onion mellows and the habanero heat spreads evenly
**Start with half the habanero.** Heat varies a lot from pepper to pepper, and you can add more after it sits
**Too hot:** add more mango and lime
